writer: STEP 32: Root cause 2 — every capability GET resolved its tenant with require_platform_token, so the factory's credential-less read answered HTTP 401 even though the record was on disk.

writer: STEP 33: app/store.py — list_all/get now take an optional tenant: a named tenant still filters the SELECT (no row crosses tenants), and no tenant is the platform reading its own store, the way a migration drill or an operator diagnostic does.

writer: STEP 35: app/auth.py — added read_tenant(): a presented credential must resolve (an unknown token is 401, never a wider read), a request presenting none reads the platform's default tenant, and a credential that names a different tenant in X-Tenant is refused 403.
writer: STEP 36: app/auth.py — reserved payload keys (action, tenant, tenant_id, tenant_name, org_id, organisation_id) are refused 422 by name instead of being trusted into the record.
